product.name: Tumodo Business Travel Platform
product.description: A cloud-based platform for booking and managing corporate travel including flights, hotels, and related services in a centralized workflow.

product.name: Travel Policy and Approval Management
product.description: A feature to set and enforce company travel policies and approval workflows to control travel expenses and ensure compliance.

product.name: Accounting and HR System Integration
product.description: Integration services that connect Tumodo with corporate accounting and HR systems to automate data transfer and document management.

identifier.value: 24/7 Customer Support and Personal Account Management

product.name: 24/7 Customer Support and Personal Account Management
product.description: Continuous customer support and dedicated account management to assist with travel bookings, changes, and platform configuration.

product.name: Travel Expense Analytics and Reporting
product.description: Tools to generate real-time reports and analytics on business travel expenses, enabling budget planning and cost control.
